Spinach Kugel
By: Yuna Wu
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




2 pkgs. frozen spinach, chopped, thawed, drained
8 oz.s thin noodles, cooked and drained
3 eggs
3 c.s sour cream
1/4 c. butter, melted
1/4 c. onions, chopped, sauteed
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 Mix the above ingredients together and pour into a 3 quart greased mold. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 1 hour.
